|errata_history=This is the original printing: the earliest PC card image of this card (21 December 2021). It is the last version before the card was cut (blanked) on 22 July 2024. The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image of 21 December 2021<ref name="ht-L_ouneetav-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8190af8/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/ouneetav.gif ouneetav.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8190af8 8190af8] (21 December 2021, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>Virtual17-Light/hires/ouneetav.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6f54fd7 6f54fd7] (20 December 2021, “Set 17 images”).</ref>, no errata mark; lower-left name “Ounee Ta (Jabba’s Palace Sealed Deck)”. Published the day after [[Virtual Set 17]] was released (20 December 2021; the high-resolution image was committed on 20 December). On 5 July 2022 the PC re-saved it as PNG data (“fixing sizes”), pixel-identical: not a version. Text: “Plays on table. At each opponent's ◊ site, your Rebels are each deploy -2 and your Force generation is +1. May lose 3 Force to cancel an attempt by [Theed Palace] Sidious to place your Jedi out of play.”
Versions follow Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error.
|notes='''Blanked:''' The Players Committee cut this shield from Virtual Set D with [[Virtual Set 23]] on 22 July 2024: the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit lists “•Ounee Ta (V) (Defensive Shield)” under “Light Side – Cut”<ref name="dskit2024">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file built 2 August 2024), released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024).</ref>. The PC card data says similar anti-Sidious text was added to [[Your Insight Serves You Well (Reflections III) (V) (Errata 2)|Your Insight Serves You Well (V)]]. A blanked card is treated as if it did not exist from that date (in effect a ban); it is not a new version. It stays in its set and is legal in period formats that end before the blanking.
